_: RFL's own advertising-board artwork (the LED panels their renderer drew), one atlas so the whole ring is one draw call. `kind` matches the exporter's board classes: w = touchline panel (2.12 m), e = end-wall panel (1.20 m), o = the south wall's outer face (2.26 m). Designs alternate round the ring exactly as gauntlet/football.py lays them out; rows are 256 px tall at each panel's true aspect (height 0.78 m).
